prompt: Choose the best option for the blank.
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格的選項。

options.text: Intake will use orange tags; the original labels are all white.
options.zh: 收件組會使用橘色標籤；原有標籤都是白色。
options.whyZh: 不同顏色讓人從外觀分辨兩種標籤，正好承接「這樣一來」。

options.text: The removable tags were ordered in packs of fifty.
options.zh: 可撕式標籤是以每包五十張訂購的。
options.whyZh: 包裝數量無法用來辨認貼在資料夾上的標籤。

options.text: Intake will sort the empty shipping boxes by size.
options.zh: 收件組會按尺寸整理空的運送箱。
options.whyZh: 整理空箱不會改變兩類標籤的外觀。

options.text: The original labels sometimes include the project name.
options.zh: 原有標籤有時會寫上專案名稱。
options.whyZh: 有些原標籤並未寫專案名稱，不能用這個特徵穩定地分辨。

explanationZh: 不同顏色讓人從外觀分辨兩種標籤，正好承接「這樣一來」。
evidence: Boxes from the planning office arrive this week. Folders with dates on their tabs may go straight to scanning. A date written only on the first page is not sufficient; the scanner reads the tab to name the output file. Set those folders on the side table, where Intake will add a removable tag. Intake will use orange tags; the original labels are all white. That way, the scanning team can distinguish Intake’s tag from an original filing label without opening the folder.
